sense.en: In the scene recounted by Zarathustra, the dwarf calls time a circle; Zarathustra angrily objects to making it too easy and then continues his question about the moment.

sense.ru: Звери говорят о колесе бытия; Заратустра рассказывает об укусе чудовища и спрашивает, не сделали ли они из этого уличную песнь.
sense.en: The animals speak of the wheel of being; Zarathustra recounts biting the monster and asks whether they have already made a barrel-organ song of that experience. Comparing his reply with the animals’ preceding speech is a reading of this sequence.

limit.en: The animals’ direct speech and his answer do not permit their words to be substituted for Zarathustra’s formula.

sense.ru: Звери воображают, что Заратустра сказал бы себе, если бы он сейчас захотел умереть.
sense.en: The animals imagine what Zarathustra would say to himself if he wanted to die now; the embedded “I” is named by them and is not spoken by him in the scene.

limit.en: The imagined speech belongs to the inner voice and is carried by the animals; the passage does not show Zarathustra’s assent.
